$comment: Gate 2.4-A evidence. Every REAL served identity is read off all six surfaces it publishes (trust JSON, evidence manifest, agent contract, trust HTML, install HTML, lookup index) and the decision-bearing facts must agree. HTML carries no machine fields, so it is measured by verbatim presence of the same value — a missing value is recorded as ABSENT(...) and fails, rather than being silently skipped. The cohort size and the per-identity surface count are asserted too, because a surface that stopped being emitted would otherwise 'agree' trivially. Regenerate with `pnpm eval:phase-2.4:gates:write`.
